City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 17, 2014 -
6:00
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a "WHITE" speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM #10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the Board if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a "PINK" speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the 11/19/2014 Regular Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2014-12-17 Item 8A - Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants List.
2014-12-17 Item 8B - Warrants
8C.
Approve the purchase of a replacement combination storm drain cleaning truck. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
1) Authorize the replacement/purchase of the described equipment from Municipal Maintenance Equipment in accordance with the attached proposal, for an amount not-to-exceed $370,522.20, plus a contingency of 5%, for a total appropriation of $389,048.31; 2) Authorize additional appropriation of $193,048.31, from fund balance in the equipment replacement fund (623) to be used with the $196,000 previously appropriated in Equipment Replacement Fund, to equal full purchase price for the vehicle including contingency; 3) Authorize the Finance Director to seek lease-financing for the purchase, in accordance with Council Policy FO30 to finance equipment purchases of $100,000 or more, under terms and conditions acceptable to the Finance Director; 4) Authorize the Public Works Department to dispose of the existing equipment in a manner consistent with the best interests of the City, and to deposit the proceeds from that process to the Equipment Replacement fund (Estimated $75,000).
2014-12-17 Item 8C - Purchase of a Storm Drain Truck
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Public Hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning and Building Department's approval of a four-parcel subdivision, grading for each parcel, and the construction of a private road. The project site is located in the Residential-3 (R-3) zone of the New Encinitas community, and in the Coastal Zone. Contact Person: Associate Planner Dichoso CASE NUMBER: 14-007 TPM/CDP; APPLICANT: Tennis Club LLC/New Urban West LOCATION: Berryman Canyon Road (APN 262-080-03)
Deny the appeal and adopt attached Draft Resolution No. 2014-69 affirming the decision of the Planning and Building Department to approve a four-parcel subdivision, grading for each parcel, and the construction of a private road for the reasons outlined under the analysis section of this report.
2014-12-17 Item 10A - New Urban West Development Appeal
10B.
Presentation of the City's 2014 Comprehensive Annual Financial Report (CAFR). Contact Person: Finance Manager Lembach
Accept and file the Comprehensive Annual Financial Report for fiscal year ended June 30, 2014.
2014-12-17 Item 10B - Presentation of City's 2014 CAFR
10C.
Appointment of Council Members to City and Regional Committees and Boards. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Discuss the Mayor's recommended appointments to City and regional committees and boards for 2015 and approve final appointments.
2014-12-17 Item 10C - 2015 Council Boards, Commissions and Committees
10D.
Appointment of applicants to fill one unscheduled vacancy on the Traffic and Public Safety Commission (at-large representative) with a term ending March 2016 and to fill one vacancy on the Senior Citizen Commission with a term ending March 2017. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
The Mayor, with approval of the City Council, shall make one appointment to the Traffic and Public Safety Commission (at-large representative) with a term ending March 2016 and one appointment to the Senior Citizen Commission with a term ending March 2017.
2014-12-17 Item 10D - Traffic and Public Safety and Senior Commission Applicants
10E.
Consideration and Adoption of City of Encinitas Legislative Program for 2015. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst McSeveney
Council reviews the City of Encinitas Legislative Program, provides staff with direction for any modifications, and adopts the 2015 Legislative Program.
2014-12-17 Item 10E - 2015 Legislative Program
10F.
Consideration of accepting City Manager Vina's resignation; and, discussion/potential action to begin the process of selecting an interim and/or permanent successor. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Consider accepting City Manager Vina's resignation; and, discuss potential action to begin the process of selecting an interim and/or permanent successor.
2014-12-17 Item 10F - City Manager Resignation
10G.
Council to review and discuss policy for issuing Proclamations. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Receive report, discuss and provide direction to staff.
2014-12-17 Item 10G - Proclamation Policy
10H.
City Council consideration of the request from Leucadia Towing and Encinitas Glass to remain as tenants at the Pacific View property.
1) the Leucadia Towing and Encinitas Glass continue as tenants at the Pacific View property, and 2) to prepare license agreements with Leucadia Towing and Encinitas Glass.
2014-12-17 Item 10H - Pacific View Tenants
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council initiated item from Council Members Shaffer and Kranz regarding sea level rise vulnerability and impacts/effects upon bluffs and beaches.
2014-12-17 Item 12 - Council Initiated Item

ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
